message: New @action endpoint — confirm a rate limit applies. 5 forum actions shipped without one (todos 104-109).
Raw SQL built with an f-string in a migration — f-strings concatenate table/column names with no escaping (injection). Use psycopg2.sql.Identifier() + a whitelist.
Custom get_permissions() must delegate custom @action names to super().get_permissions(), or action-level permission_classes are silently ignored (security hole).
Import router hooks from 'react-router-dom', not 'react-router' — the bare package silently crashes at runtime (Cannot read properties of undefined).
Use isinstance(instance, BlogPostPage), not hasattr(...page...), for Wagtail page-type checks in signal handlers — multi-table inheritance makes hasattr unreliable.
Non-atomic increment of a model-field counter (obj.x_count += 1) races under concurrency. Use an F() expression: .update(x_count=F('x_count') + 1).
scripts/kimi-review is a drift-checked vendored engine; editing it directly fails the pre-commit gate (check-kimi-engine.sh). Sync from canonical via scripts/sync-kimi-engine.sh instead.
Celery: `task_*` names are GLOBAL config settings and are INERT as @shared_task/@app.task decorator kwargs. Use the unprefixed per-task options: acks_late= / reject_on_worker_lost=.

Count("id") or Count("uuid") 500s on models with a non-standard PK (UUID, custom). Use Count("pk") — it resolves to the real primary key on every model. Caught by Phase-6 code review after the analytics endpoint regressed (2026-06-02 audit).

Bare format_html() with no interpolation args raises TypeError on Django 6.0 (silent on 5.x). Use mark_safe() for trusted static HTML, or pass a format arg like format_html with {} plus a value (e.g. static()).

Migrations must never create accounts or call management commands — RunPython re-runs the command's CURRENT code on every fresh migrate (blog 0004 minted a hardcoded-password superuser on every deploy). Inline with apps.get_model(); no-op served one-time migrations.

Seed/demo/E2E command with a literal password and no DEBUG gate — add `if not settings.DEBUG: raise CommandError(...)` at the top of handle(), and use set_unusable_password() for byline-only accounts.
Model-signal @receiver without sender= registers for EVERY model: project-wide fast-delete is disabled and the handler runs on all saves/deletes. Pass sender='app.Model' (lazy string works).

Editing .secrets.baseline by hand churns line numbers and drops audit decisions. If a test PLACEHOLDER is re-flagged, add `# pragma: allowlist secret` on that line instead — it survives line shifts. To refresh the baseline safely, run scripts/refresh-secrets-baseline.sh (uses `scan --baseline`, not `scan >`).
String(sanitizeError(...)) renders the literal '[object Object]' if you pass the error OBJECT. Render result.error?.message (a string) instead — sanitize* helpers no-op on non-strings.
Pin @tiptap/extension-* to the EXACT @tiptap/core version (no caret) — a caret resolves to a newer 3.x whose peer @tiptap/core mismatches the pinned core → npm ERESOLVE. See docs/rules/react.md.

drf-spectacular view registered — confirm it's gated. These default to SERVE_PERMISSIONS=[AllowAny] (anonymous-readable schema + Swagger/Redoc); set SPECTACULAR_SETTINGS["SERVE_PERMISSIONS"]=[IsAdminUser] in settings.py (or per-path permission_classes) and note it here (todo 248).

jsdom makes window.location.assign/replace/reload NON-configurable — vi.spyOn(window.location, 'assign') throws 'Cannot redefine property: assign'. Replace the whole window.location via Object.defineProperty in beforeEach (restore in afterEach). See web/docs/patterns/testing.md.

Package generics views inherit host DEFAULT_FILTER_BACKENDS: a client ?ordering= overrides cursor ordering and can 500 via dotted serializer sources. Pin filter_backends = [] (order is a package contract).

workflow.start(obj, user) makes the auto-approval completion hook publish permission-checked AS requested_by (PublishPermissionError for non-moderators). Pass None; attribute via revision.publish(user=..., skip_permission_checks=True).
Rendering/iterating a resolved StreamValue bulk-fetches image blocks PER OBJECT (N+1, reintroduced twice) — build excerpts/text from stream_value.raw_data instead (docs/rules/wagtail.md).
Array(n).fill(makeX()) puts ONE shared object in every slot (duplicate React keys, cross-item mutation). Use Array.from({length: n}, (_, i) => makeX({id: i})).

A DB-writing call added inside dispatch()'s signal-fired branches runs in an already-open ambient transaction — wrap it in its own `with transaction.atomic():` plus an outer try/except, or an unguarded DB error will abort the Postgres transaction underneath send_robust's swallow and break the next query in the same transaction.

A queryset over a model with a topic/board FK filters only by recipient/owner — every other queryset in this package also gates on topic__live and board__in=_visible_boards() (PageViewRestriction is not auto-enforced); add the same visibility filter here.

A new swagger_fake_view guard in get_queryset() needs a direct unit test (view.swagger_fake_view = True; view.get_queryset()) — drf-spectacular never calls get_queryset() for a ListAPIView's schema, so schema-content tests can't catch the guard's removal.
Assert the exact status code, not a (401, 403) set — this project's DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES (CookieJWTAuthentication first) makes anonymous-vs-IsAuthenticated outcomes deterministic per view.
A bare `dict` in @extend_schema(responses=...) documents an opaque/untyped object — define an inline JSON-schema dict (see CAPABILITIES_SCHEMA/AUTHOR_SCHEMA in api/serializers.py) instead.

Verify this is paired with a lookup that BYPASSES Django ORM pattern-lookups (raw SQL, .extra(), a custom Lookup) — icontains/istartswith/endswith/iendswith (and their non-i forms) already auto-escape %/_/\\ via PatternLookup.process_rhs(); stacking escape_search_query() on top double-escapes and silently breaks real matches.

A custom TipTap renderHTML override that never calls mergeAttributes() silently drops the configured HTMLAttributes (styling/data attrs) — check whether the vendor default (node_modules/@tiptap/<pkg>/dist/index.js) already does this correctly before writing an override at all.

except IntegrityError wrapping get_or_create/update_or_create — Django already retries its own .get() internally and only re-raises when that retry ALSO fails; a redundant wrapper masks a clean IntegrityError as a confusing DoesNotExist. Verify against requirements.txt Django version before assuming a fallback is needed.

firebase_admin.initialize_app() without a ValueError catch — under threaded runserver two concurrent first-touch requests can both miss get_app() and both initialize; the loser raises 'default app already exists'. Catch ValueError and adopt via firebase_admin.get_app() (todo 253 slice 6 review).

A tray-visible FCM Notification block in a multi-event task must WHITELIST events (helper returns None for the rest): moderation/publish signals fire on every routine autopublish, so an unscoped block pops 'Your post was published' at users for their own ordinary posts (todo 253 slice 6 review, cross-file tracer).

credentials.Certificate(path) reads/parses the file EAGERLY and raises at call time (unlike lazy ApplicationDefault). On a request path, guard it so a missing/malformed key file degrades to a handled auth failure, not a 500 on every login (todo 253 slice 6 review, removed-behavior auditor).

Per-object FCM collapse key — FCM retains at most 4 distinct collapse keys per offline device, so unique per-post/topic keys silently drop the rest of an offline backlog. Use a per-EVENT-TYPE key (still dedupes retry-after-timeout); the bell/in-app list is the complete record (todo 253 slice 6).

Page.objects.filter(depth=1) is the UNROUTABLE treebeard root, not the site root — pages attached there get url=None and route() never reaches them. Resolve Site.objects.get(is_default_site=True).root_page instead (audit 2026-07-17 H1).

django_db(transaction=True) teardown-flushes Wagtail migration-seeded rows (root page/collection/Site) — passes standalone, breaks in-suite, and breaks later tests. Simulate the interleaving deterministically instead (monkeypatch the fast-path check; see wagtail_forum/tests/test_collections.py).

Hardcoded admin-mount URL in a wagtail hook — resolves to a silent 404 if the mount changes or the package is reused. Use reverse(Model.snippet_viewset.get_url_name(...)) / reverse("blog_admin:<name>") inside the hook function body (audit 2026-07-17 M1/M2).
jsdom implements scrollIntoView on HTMLElement.prototype — a spy on Element.prototype is shadowed (records 0 calls). Spy on HTMLElement.prototype.scrollIntoView instead.

Host-side forum view/task querying Topic must enforce board visibility: use _get_visible_topic(topic_id) or Topic.objects.filter(..., board__in=_visible_boards()) (from wagtail_forum.api.views). PageViewRestriction is NOT auto-enforced — else a restricted board`s content leaks (todo 255 slice 3 HIGH authz bypass). Filter the SOURCE too, not just the response.

Host-side forum view/task querying Topic/Post must make an explicit per-user BLOCK-visibility decision, not just board visibility: apply _exclude_blocked_authors/_should_filter_blocks (or thread user= through to a package helper that already does — see find_similar_topics), OR record why not with a 'Deliberately NOT block-filtered' comment (e.g. no authenticated viewer exists, or the surface has a shared cross-user/cross-reader cache that per-viewer filtering would poison or fragment). apps/forum_host/ is invisible to filtering added only inside the wagtail_forum package — this exact blind spot has already bitten twice (todo 255 H14 for board visibility, then todo 284 M9 for block visibility on semantic_search.py/similar.py/summary.py).
source: codify: todo 284 (advisor-caught, 2nd occurrence of the H14 package-only-filtering blind spot)

message: Hardcoded URL namespace in reverse() — a mountable package must resolve within request.resolver_match.namespace (see _created_location), else NoReverseMatch 500 under the nested/root host mount.

Shared-cache header (s-maxage) added: Vary MUST cover every auth scheme. CookieJWTAuthentication falls back to the Authorization header (mobile), so Vary: Cookie alone leaks the anon copy to a header-authed request. Use patch_vary_headers(resp, ("Cookie","Authorization")); gate the public branch on anonymous + status<400; no-store authed and side-effect/moderation-removal reads. See backend/docs/patterns/architecture/caching.md
User-facing forum API error strings are translated: wrap in gettext_lazy — raise Conflict(_("...")). Use %(name)s interpolation, not an f-string, so it stays lazy.

Playwright .spec.ts NEVER runs authenticated: the authed projects testMatch /(forum-authenticated|auth)\.spec\.js/ (.js only), so this spec always runs signed-out with no storageState. Fine for anonymous coverage; if it needs a signed-in view, name it *.spec.js or widen the authed testMatch AND the anonymous testIgnore together. See docs/LEARNINGS.md 2026-07-29 (todo 270).

transaction.on_commit() does NOT defer here: ATOMIC_REQUESTS=False and no explicit atomic() means Django's autocommit branch runs the callback immediately, inline, in-request. Do not claim it is deferred, outside the request, or free of the pinned query count. Note the trap: under @pytest.mark.django_db the callback DOES defer (and rolls back unrun), so a green assertNumQueries pin cannot detect the production cost. robust=True is still honored on the immediate path.

strip_tags() substitutes NOTHING for a tag and decodes no entities: "

a

b

" -> "ab" and "

 

" -> truthy " ". If this text is consumed as prose (LLM prompt, email, excerpt, search doc), substitute block boundaries with newlines FIRST, then strip, then html.unescape — and test with a MULTI-block fixture (a single

cannot exhibit the bug).

TipTap parses a STRING passed to insertContent() as HTML, so any text you did not author (model/API output) becomes real document structure in the post the user publishes. Build nodes instead: insertContent([{type:"paragraph", content:[{type:"text", text: line}]}]) — the array branch goes through schema.nodeFromJSON, never DOMParser.

A TaggableManager exposed via BOTH a FieldPanel and a DRF serializer has two write paths — the CMS admin widget runs no serializer code, and taggit Tag.name is case-SENSITIVE. Normalize on both paths, or make reads path-agnostic with __iexact + .distinct() (an M2M iexact can match two Tag rows and duplicate a row).

ListField(max_length=…) is enforced by a validator that runs AFTER to_internal_value has child-validated every element, so it cannot bound the work a request triggers. Check the raw length first in a to_internal_value override, and dedup with a set/dict — an "if x not in list" accumulator over request input is O(n^2).

Reusable package: use get_user_model()._base_manager, not _default_manager. A host whose User model filters its default manager (soft-delete/active-only) returns None for those rows, and a None-fallback then silently degrades for exactly those accounts. _base_manager is unfiltered by contract.

New peek-then-consume AI budget — what bounds the calls that never reach consume_budget()? A timed-out provider call was still issued and is still billed, so a success-only counter stops capping spend exactly when the provider misbehaves. If failures are billable, add a SEPARATE attempts counter that trips the opposite posture (hold, not degrade) — see the forum spam backend.

String method called on request.data.get(...) — under MultiPartParser request.data MERGES POST and FILES, so a text field sent as a FILE part is an UploadedFile and .strip() raises AttributeError (500, not 400). Guard with isinstance(value, str). Happy-path tests send it as a field and never catch this.

setState with a functional updater inside an unmount cleanup — React DISCARDS the update without invoking the updater, so any release/cleanup work inside it silently never runs (measured 0 calls, todo 281). Mirror the value into a useRef and read the ref in the cleanup; test the unmount path specifically.

Hardcoded cookie samesite= killed all cross-site prod auth (PR #530). Derive from settings.SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE (force secure=True when it is "None") and scope cookie path= to the live /api/v1/ mount.

TestCase POSTing to a login endpoint without cache.clear() in setUp: django-ratelimit counters bleed across classes in one process (>5 logins -> 429s, order-dependent flake). Clear the cache first thing in setUp.

Implicit-return beforeEach with a mock call: Vitest 4 registers the returned mock as a TEARDOWN and re-invokes it post-test (replays configured rejections). Use a block body: beforeEach(() => { mock.mockReset(); }).

Raw --canopy-* ramp var in a CSS property position: the ramp is mode-blind (PR #537 flash ring was invisible in light mode). Use the --gt-* semantic token; raw ramp vars belong only in the :root/[data-mode] token-definition blocks.

Unscoped forum link selector in an e2e spec: the AppShell header carries /forum/search + /forum/new-thread links on EVERY page, so this matches chrome before page content. Scope to #main-content (e.g. #main-content a[href^="/forum/...").
get_rendition() 500s the endpoint when the source media file is missing (SourceImageIOError on cache miss) — wrap in try/except (SourceImageIOError, OSError), log [ERROR], degrade to null.
Never set document.body.style.overflow directly — composing components corrupt each other. Use the ref-counted useBodyScrollLock(open) hook (web/src/hooks/useBodyScrollLock.ts).

A hook comparing a git-resolved path (git rev-parse --show-toplevel) against a raw path string risks symlink desync (e.g. macOS /tmp -> /private/tmp resolves one side but not the other). Resolve BOTH sides the same way (two --show-toplevel calls) before comparing — never one resolved value against one raw string. See docs/LEARNINGS.md 2026-08-29 (guard-main-branch-edit.sh, PR #576).

Wiring full_clean() into a model's save() also runs validate_constraints() (Django 4.1+): a UniqueConstraint violation becomes a pre-save ValidationError instead of the IntegrityError an existing 'except IntegrityError:' savepoint handler (e.g. for a 409) expects — check docs/rules/database.md before wiring this into save().

New @action on a Wagtail viewset — WagtailAPIRouter/get_urlpatterns() does NOT auto-mount @action methods (only listing_view/detail_view/find_view). Route it via extra_action_urlpatterns() (or a manual path() entry) in urls.py, or it 404s despite passing tests. 6 of 7 actions on BlogPostPageViewSet shipped this way (todo 307).

GIN trigram index on a bare column may never be used: Django compiles icontains to UPPER(col) LIKE UPPER(%s) on PostgreSQL, not ILIKE — index UPPER(col), not the raw column, or verify via Model.objects.filter(x__icontains=...).query first.

TrigramExtension() reverse unconditionally runs DROP EXTENSION with no dependent-object check — fails to roll back once another app has trigram indexes depending on the same shared extension. Use RunPython: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS forward, migrations.RunPython.noop reverse.

retry_backoff=True on an autoretry_for task is a backoff FACTOR of 1 (~1s/2s/4s jittered) and default_retry_delay is never read on that path. Pass the delay itself: retry_backoff=<seconds constant>, and pin the countdowns (push_request + mocked retry + jitter patched to max).

A .delay() straight from a signal receiver races the commit: Wagtail admin publish and Model.delete() cascades fire page_published/post_delete INSIDE atomic(), so the worker can read the pre-commit row. Wrap it: transaction.on_commit(lambda: task.delay(pk)), try/except inside the callback; test with django_capture_on_commit_callbacks.

search_documents() may only be called by vector_indexes._scored_search — it owns the FORUM_VECTOR_SEARCH_ENABLED gate, the query cap and the EMBED_BUDGET peek-then-consume, and an unsliced result silently caps at 20. Use find_similar_topics() (Topic pks) or retrieve_grounding_passages() (scored + floored) instead.

An error envelope built as message=str(exc) renders a dict/list DRF detail (every field-level ValidationError, nested serializers included) as the Python repr of ErrorDetail objects, and web pages show message verbatim. Route it through apps.core.exceptions.readable_message (host) / _readable_message (wagtail_forum package twin) and keep both in step — test_exception_envelope.py pins them to one table (todo 320).
